info.title: EEGLayoutLab
info.description: Local service API. Request formats are defined in eeglayoutlab.schemas. The schemas describe the canonical form of each request; the service also accepts the spellings the Node host accepts for default values (contracts/README.md).

RadiusSearchRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /api/local-compute/jobs`` and ``/lookup`` in its canonical form: a free mode has no
``mask_codes``, and the independent noise model is left out. In preset mode ``mask_codes`` lists exactly
``region_count`` sites, repeats allowed, in order.
